title: Measuring and Decomposing Mode Separation via the Canonical Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2605.08777v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mode separation, namely how sharply a distribution fragments into barrier-separated clusters, is a fundamental geometric property of densities, difficult to quantify in high dimensions. Modes are often the meaningful alternatives in the data, such as the conformations of a molecule or the distinct semantic types among a generative model's outputs. Mode separation is distinct from dispersion, which is what standard label-free tools capture: differential entropy rises with spread regardless of fragmentation, and PCA orders directions by variance regardless of barriers. Mutual information does capture it, but only given the latent component labels, which are usually unavailable. We measure mode separation through a single stochastic process intrinsic to the density, namely the unique reversible diffusion with $f$ as its stationary distribution and a constant scalar diffusion coefficient. translated_title: 通过规范扩散测量与分解模态分离
translated_abstract: 模态分离，即一个分布被势垒分隔成簇的锐利程度，是密度的基本几何属性，在高维空间中难以量化。模态往往是数据中有意义的选项，例如分子的构象，或生成模型输出中不同的语义类型。模态分离不同于离散度，而后者正是标准无标签工具所捕获的内容：微分熵随散布程度增大而上升，与是否碎裂无关；PCA 按方差对方向排序，与势垒无关。互信息确实能够捕获模态分离，但前提是给定潜在的成分标签，而这通常是不可获得的。我们通过密度所固有的单一随机过程来测量模态分离，即以 $f$ 为平稳分布且扩散系数为常数的唯一可逆扩散过程（规范扩散）。从其自协方差矩阵中，我们提取出两个……
tldr: 该论文提出以密度固有的唯一常数扩散系数可逆扩散过程（规范扩散）为基准，从其自协方差矩阵中提取量来测量并分解高维分布的模态分离程度，弥补了微分熵、PCA 等无标签工具无法刻画势垒分隔结构、而互信息又依赖潜在标签的不足。
